change: crates/incular-widgets/src/animated_size.rs: AnimatedSize::reverse_duration builder and reverse_duration_value getter; forwarded to the controller with set_reverse_duration at creation and on update.
harness: none; Flutter only runs the size animation forward, so no frame difference exists.
note: Reclassified from invalid: source compatibility is cheap here.

root_cause: No DeviceGestureSettings: every recognizer used kTouchSlop and kPanSlop regardless of the platform.
change: incular-core DeviceGestureSettings (touch_slop, pan_slop, from_physical); incular-gestures slop.rs compute_hit_slop/compute_pan_slop take settings, and the pointer, scale, tap-and-drag, multi-tap, multi-drag and force-press recognizers store them; incular-config RuntimeEnvironment::gesture_settings; incular-widgets tree gesture_settings_at hands the nearest MediaQuery settings to detector, scale and scroll-drag recognizers. trackpadScrollCausesScale was fixed in the gestures-api pass.
harness: gestures__ 11/11 match; no scenario overrides the slop.
api_change: added DeviceGestureSettings, RuntimeEnvironment::gesture_settings, public compute_hit_slop/compute_pan_slop and set_gesture_settings/gesture_settings on recognizers
limitations: No Android or iOS host exists to report a platform touch slop; desktop and web report none, as Flutter embedders do.
